name: Loalia — Customer Reviews with Photos & Videos for WooCommerce
author: loaliaes

sections.description:
Loalia collects your customers’ reviews and shows them on your site in five different layouts: card grid, carousel, review wall, rating badge and featured quote.

What makes it different: your reviews are written INSIDE your page.

Almost every plugin that brings in reviews from an external source drops them into a separate frame (an iframe). To Google, that frame is a different page: it does not count as your content. This plugin requests the reviews from Loalia on your own server and writes them into your page’s HTML, with their structured data alongside. Google sees them, and your site loads faster because there is no frame to open.

What it does

  • Five widget layouts, all using the design you pick from your Loalia dashboard.
  • Block editor block, with a live preview of your real reviews while you build the page.
  • Elementor widget, to drag wherever you want.
  • Shortcodes for Divi, WPBakery, Bricks or any page builder, and a classic widget for sidebars.
  • WooCommerce: reviews below each product page and the average rating with stars next to the title, with product structured data.
  • “Leave a review” button, with four possible positions.
  • Automatic requests after each WooCommerce order: a few days after a purchase the request email goes out, with the product already linked and a test mode included. On a connected site Loalia sends it; otherwise your own WordPress does.
  • Seven languages on your site: the widget labels (button, “verified”, dates, totals) appear automatically in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian or Dutch, following your site’s language. Reviews are never translated.
  • The look from your Loalia dashboard, actually applied: card shape, colors, background, typography, border and button.
  • Photos, videos, verified purchase and business replies.
  • Incentivized-review notice (EU Omnibus Directive).

You need a Loalia account

This plugin shows the reviews you already have on Loalia. There is a free plan, and you can create your account during the connection step, without leaving the setup. Press “Connect with Loalia” and you are done; if you prefer, you can instead paste the public token you find in your dashboard.

Reviews, moderation and emails are managed from the Loalia dashboard, so they apply the same way to this site and to any store you run elsewhere. Your QR code design (colors, center image and tagline) is saved on this site.

External services

This plugin is the WordPress side of Loalia (https://loalia.es), where your reviews live. It needs a Loalia account (free plan). Nothing is sent until you paste your public token or connect your site.

  • Showing your reviews. The plugin fetches them from loalia.es every fifteen minutes and caches them. Each call sends your public token, the product id and display mode on product pages, and your site address in the user agent. The review button opens your form on loalia.es.
  • Photos, videos, avatars. Review media and profile pictures are served from loalia.es and loaded by each visitor’s browser (in the admin too, with your logo and email images), so their IP and user agent reach loalia.es. The images and videos you save in Studio › My creations are also loaded by your browser straight from loalia.es, through a private link that expires after a few hours.
  • Connecting your site (optional). “Connect with Loalia” sends your browser to loalia.es with your site address and name, platform, dashboard language and return URL, where you sign in. Loalia returns a one-time voucher that your server exchanges for a connection key, used server to server.
  • What a connected site sends. On connect and daily: your site name, the plugin version, your WooCommerce products (id, SKU, name, thumbnail, status; up to 500), your coupons (code, description, amount, status, expiry; up to 300) and three admin URLs; every fifteen minutes it also reads your Console choices. One-time coupons (off by default) are created in WooCommerce and their codes sent.
  • Your customers’ order data. Only with automatic review requests on: when a WooCommerce order is completed, its id, number and date, the customer’s first name, email, products bought and your store language are sent. With requests off no customer data leaves your site; unconnected, your own WordPress sends that email.
  • The Loalia tabs. They are pages of this plugin: nothing from loalia.es is embedded. Your server, not your browser, calls the Loalia API with a console session, only while you have the tab open or press a button; your browser only loads from loalia.es the images and videos listed above. What travels: review id, action, reply and product (Console); style settings (Design); template texts, test sends and the header image you upload (Emails); the CSV file, the screenshot or the address of the page of your own site you choose (Import); widget format and title (Widgets); generated text or images (Studio); discounts, the prize wheel, the video script and automatic-request settings (Collect); your business name and logo (Your business); your plan.
  • Card payments. The pay button opens Stripe’s checkout on loalia.es; no card data touches WordPress.

Terms: https://loalia.es/terminos.html – Privacy: https://loalia.es/privacidad.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the loalia-reviews folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip from Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Open the Loalia menu and press Connect with Loalia. You will sign in to your Loalia account on loalia.es, or create a free one right there, and you will come back connected.
  4. Choose where you want your reviews to appear, in the “Where they show” tab.

If you prefer not to connect the site, you can just paste your public token in the plugin Settings (you will find it in your Loalia dashboard, under Widgets): the reviews will show, without the console.
sections.faq:
Is it free? What are Loalia’s plans?

The plugin is free and nothing in it is locked: everything it does on your site works the same with any account (the five layouts, the widget’s colors and shape, the QR code, the prize wheel and the data for Google).

Loalia, the service where your reviews are stored, has a free plan and two paid plans. On the free plan, all your reviews are published during the first month and 10 are published after that; you can keep collecting and none are deleted. The paid plans add things done by the service, not by the plugin: publishing all your reviews with no limit, designing the emails Loalia sends for you, AI-written phrases, email support and, on the Agency plan, managing several clients from one account. Pricing: https://loalia.es/precios.html

Does it slow my site down?

No. Reviews are requested from Loalia once every fifteen minutes (you can change that) and stored on your own site, so other visits do not go out to the internet to fetch them.

What if Loalia does not respond?

The last reviews that were stored are shown, for up to a week. Your site is never left with an empty gap because of it.

Will my stars show in Google?

On WooCommerce product pages Google gets the product’s rating. Showing the stars is Google’s decision and takes weeks; no one can guarantee it. On other pages Google does not show stars for a business’s own reviews.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce only adds the reviews on product pages. Everything else works on any WordPress site.

Is the token a password?

No. It only identifies your public reviews — the same ones already shown in your widget. It gives no access to your account.

What third-party code does the plugin bundle?

Third-party code and fonts bundled with the plugin, all GPL-compatible, each with its full licence beside it: QR Code Generator for JavaScript by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licence (assets/lib/qrcode.js); and the Familjen Grotesk, Manrope, Playfair Display, Poppins and Roboto typefaces, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (assets/fuentes/).
sections.changelog:
3.6.4

  • Nothing is locked. Everything the plugin does on your site works the same with any account: the five layouts, the whole Design tab and your QR code design, now saved on this site.
  • Reviews are always written into your page. The old “separate frame” mode and the floating pop-up were removed: the plugin no longer loads any script from loalia.es on your site.
  • Import now has three sources: your own site (with AI), a CSV file and a screenshot. “Your site” only accepts addresses on this same site. Reviews without stars get the ones you choose.
  • Store reviews shown on a product say so (“about the store”).
  • Fixed: the floating review button and [loalia_boton] on connected sites; a false error when saving a screenshot review. Sizes and colours count as their product.
  • Removed: Design’s “mark after-order reviews” tool and the code for non-WordPress sites (now in your Loalia dashboard). CSV import asks you to confirm the reviews are real.
  • Under the hood: stricter permission checks and escaping, QR library 2.0.4.
